posts.title: M.J.E.R.D. Enterprise Continues Evaluating Acquisition Opportunities
posts.excerpt: M.J.E.R.D. Enterprise, Inc. is evaluating established operating businesses for potential long-term acquisition. No acquisition has closed to date.
posts.body: M.J.E.R.D. Enterprise, Inc. is evaluating established operating businesses for potential long-term acquisition. No acquisition has closed to date. All potential transactions remain subject to diligence, financing, and definitive agreements.

posts.title: M.J.E.R.D. Enterprise Completes Delaware C-Corporation Conversion
posts.excerpt: M.J.E.R.D. Enterprise, Inc. successfully converts to a Delaware C-Corporation, establishing its institutional legal foundation for long-term acquisition activity.
posts.body: M.J.E.R.D. Enterprise, Inc. has successfully completed its conversion to a Delaware C-Corporation and foreign-qualified in Florida. The company operates from its Boynton Beach, Florida headquarters under a governance structure built for disciplined, long-term acquisition activity.

posts.title: Preliminary Review of Potential Acquisition Opportunity Underway
posts.excerpt: M.J.E.R.D. Enterprise is conducting preliminary review of a potential operating-business acquisition opportunity. Any historical information remains subject to independent verification.
posts.body: M.J.E.R.D. Enterprise has begun preliminary review of a potential acquisition opportunity in the operating business sector. Any historical operating information has been derived from materials provided by the seller and remains subject to independent verification through due diligence. No definitive acquisition agreement has been announced. No acquisition is guaranteed or completed. This update is provided for general informational purposes only.

posts.title: M.J.E.R.D. Enterprise Founded
posts.excerpt: Martin J. Dacelin founds M.J.E.R.D. Enterprise, Inc. with a long-term ownership mission and a disciplined approach to business acquisition.
posts.body: Martin J. Dacelin founds M.J.E.R.D. Enterprise, Inc. with a disciplined long-term ownership mission. The company is built to evaluate, acquire, and steward established operating businesses over the long term, guided by six core investment principles and a generational legacy vision.
